title: insight-kit AGENT.md Frontmatter
description: Schema for the YAML frontmatter block in .agents/agents/<role>/AGENT.md files.

name.description: Canonical agent name (matches directory name under .agents/agents/)

description.description: One-sentence description of the agent's mandate and primary output

phase.description: Work phase label (e.g., ingest, derive, critique, render, evaluate, annotate, operate)

modes.description: Supported execution modes (e.g., human, worker, spike, per-run, sensitivity)

skills_using.description: Skills this agent relies on (must resolve via local, global, or domain_bundle resolution order)

personas_compatible.description: Personas this agent can be composed with (derived by inverting composes_with in each persona.md)

last_verified.description: ISO date when frontmatter was last verified against codebase

validated_against.description: insight-kit version or commit SHA this AGENT.md was validated against
